changelog:
- Scrolling the home page no longer stutters: a cursor rule made every new row restyle the whole page, and the hero's timer no longer runs every frame.
- The home hero loads only the title on screen and the next one, at a smaller size, instead of all eight backdrops at once.
- Title pages fetch the title once instead of up to eight times.
- Request progress checks slow down while nothing is downloading, and stop while the row is off screen or the tab is hidden.
- Long person filmographies, and the Available and Declined request lists, show the first titles with a button for the rest.
- Collections, badges, request lists and Discover do far fewer library lookups on the server, and an upstream outage is no longer remembered for hours.
description: Apple TV-style theme, home hero and season shelves for the web client.
name: Hera TV
overview: The Apple TV app's look for Jellyfin's web client
